commands.cmd: p=$(command -v jcodemunch-mcp) && echo "resolves: $p -> $(readlink -f "$p")" && jcodemunch-mcp --version && python3 -c "import json,glob,sys;c=sys.argv[1];print('stack',[x['version'] for x in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if x['id']==c],'winner pins',sorted({w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers',[]) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id')==c}))" jcodemunch-mcp

d=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1; mkdir -p "$d/code-index" "$d/home" || exit 1; before_home=$(ls -A "$HOME/.code-index" 2>/dev/null | wc -l); bin=$(command -v jcodemunch-mcp); python3 - "$d" "$bin" <<'PY'
import json, re, subprocess, sys
scratch, binary = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
env = {"CODE_INDEX_PATH": scratch + "/code-index", "JCODEMUNCH_SHARE_SAVINGS": "0", "HOME": scratch + "/home"}

def order(payload):
    args = ["mcporter", "call", "--stdio", binary]
    for k, v in env.items():
        args += ["--env", f"{k}={v}"]
    args += ["--name", "jcodemunch", "--tool", "order", "--args", json.dumps(payload),
             "--output", "json", "--no-oauth", "--timeout", "60000"]
    out = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=90)
    return json.loads(out.stdout, strict=False), out.returncode

indexed, rc1 = order({"action": "index_folder", "args": {
    "path": "scripts", "use_ai_summaries": False,
    "extra_ignore_patterns": ["**/__pycache__/**"], "follow_symlinks": False, "context_providers": False},
    "allow_state_change": True})
repo = indexed.get("repo")
print("index_folder success:", indexed.get("success"), "| repo:", repo, "| files:", indexed.get("file_count"),
      "| symbols:", indexed.get("symbol_count"), "| languages:", indexed.get("languages"))

found, rc2 = order({"action": "search_symbols", "args": {"repo": repo, "query": "catalog_component_version",
                    "kind": "function", "max_results": 5}})
text = found["content"][0]["text"]
aliases = dict(re.findall(r"^@(\d+)=(.+)$", text, re.M))
sid = None
for line in text.splitlines():
    if line.startswith("s,") and ",catalog_component_version,function," in line:
        raw = line.split(",")[1]
        m = re.match(r"^@(\d+)::(.+)$", raw)
        sid = (aliases[m.group(1)] + "::" + m.group(2)) if m else raw
        break
print("search_symbols found id:", sid)

source, rc3 = order({"action": "get_symbol_source", "args": {"repo": repo, "symbol_id": sid}})
negative, rc4 = order({"action": "search_symbols", "args": {"repo": repo,
                       "query": "zzz_native_ci_nonexistent_symbol_xyz", "kind": "function", "max_results": 5}})
neg_ids = []
if "content" in negative:
    ntext = negative["content"][0]["text"]
    naliases = dict(re.findall(r"^@(\d+)=(.+)$", ntext, re.M))
    for line in ntext.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("s,"):
            raw = line.split(",")[1]
            m = re.match(r"^@(\d+)::(.+)$", raw)
            neg_ids.append((naliases[m.group(1)] + "::" + m.group(2)) if m else raw)

real = open("scripts/host_receipts.py").read().splitlines()
want_src = "\n".join(real[source["line"] - 1:source["end_line"]])
match = source.get("source", "").rstrip("\n") == want_src.rstrip("\n")
print("get_symbol_source lines %d-%d, source equals checkout: %s" % (source.get("line"), source.get("end_line"), match))
print("negative-control query's top ids (no zero-result floor at this corpus size, recorded as observed):", neg_ids)
print("positive symbol id absent from the negative-control's top results:", sid not in neg_ids)

import pathlib
scoped_files = sorted(p.name for p in pathlib.Path(scratch, "code-index").iterdir())
home_index_dir = pathlib.Path(env["HOME"], ".code-index")
home_listing = sorted(p.name for p in home_index_dir.iterdir()) if home_index_dir.exists() else []
print("server-HOME fallback .code-index (expected, contained in scratch HOME per native_token_ci.py):", home_listing)
ok = (indexed.get("success") is True and repo and sid == "scripts/host_receipts.py::catalog_component_version#function"
      and match and sid not in neg_ids and all(rc == 0 for rc in (rc1, rc2, rc3, rc4))
      and any("native-agent-stack" in f for f in scoped_files))
print("index state under scratch CODE_INDEX_PATH:", scoped_files)
raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)
PY
rc=$?; after_home=$(ls -A "$HOME/.code-index" 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo "this host's real ~/.code-index entries before/after: $before_home/$after_home"; rm -rf "$d"; test "$rc" -eq 0 && test "$before_home" -eq "$after_home"
